page.intro: Fine cloth, structured shoulders, a line that settles a room before you speak. Every suit comes with free in-store alterations, and anything not on the rail can be made for you.
page.seo: ELIJAYS Men's Wear on Muindi Mbingu Street stocks suits for men who need presence in Nairobi boardrooms, courtrooms and wedding rooms. Choose two-piece, three-piece, blazer, tuxedo or wedding cuts, then finish the fit with free in-store alterations. Prefer a private cut? Book a bespoke fitting and we will measure, cloth and build the suit for you alone. Shop online, reserve to try, or walk in at the Biashara Street junction, opposite Equity Bank.
